tools.name: get_wallet_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Looks up a wallet address on an EVM chain and returns its native balance, token balances with USD values, and recent transaction count. Only reads data from the RPC node and price API.

params.name: wallet_address
params.description: Hex address of the wallet to inspect

params.name: token_contracts
params.description: List of ERC-20 contract addresses to check

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from web3 import Web3
from langchain.tools import tool

_RPC_URL = os.environ.get("ETH_RPC_URL", "https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/demo")
_PRICE_URL = "https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/token_price/ethereum"
_ERC20_ABI = [
    {"constant": True, "inputs": [{"name": "o", "type": "address"}], "name": "balanceOf", "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "uint256"}], "type": "function"},
    {"constant": True, "inputs": [], "name": "decimals", "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "uint8"}], "type": "function"},
    {"constant": True, "inputs": [], "name": "symbol", "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "string"}], "type": "function"},
]


@tool
def get_wallet_portfolio_summary(wallet_address: str, token_contracts: list) -> dict:
    w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(_RPC_URL))
    address = Web3.to_checksum_address(wallet_address)
    native_wei = w3.eth.get_balance(address)
    native_balance = float(Web3.from_wei(native_wei, "ether"))
    tx_count = w3.eth.get_transaction_count(address)

    eth_price = requests.get(
        "https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price",
        params={"ids": "ethereum", "vs_currencies": "usd"},
        timeout=10,
    ).json()["ethereum"]["usd"]

    contracts = [Web3.to_checksum_address(c) for c in token_contracts]
    prices = requests.get(
        _PRICE_URL,
        params={"contract_addresses": ",".join(contracts), "vs_currencies": "usd"},
        timeout=10,
    ).json()

    tokens = []
    for contract_address in contracts:
        contract = w3.eth.contract(address=contract_address, abi=_ERC20_ABI)
        decimals = contract.functions.decimals().call()
        symbol = contract.functions.symbol().call()
        raw = contract.functions.balanceOf(address).call()
        amount = raw / (10 ** decimals)
        price = prices.get(contract_address.lower(), {}).get("usd", 0)
        tokens.append({"symbol": symbol, "contract": contract_address, "balance": amount, "usd_value": round(amount * price, 2)})

    total_usd = native_balance * eth_price + sum(t["usd_value"] for t in tokens)
    return {
        "address": address,
        "native_balance": native_balance,
        "native_usd": round(native_balance * eth_price, 2),
        "tokens": tokens,
        "transaction_count": tx_count,
        "total_usd": round(total_usd, 2),
    }

tools.name: add_multisig_signer
tools.description: Adds a new signer to a team multisig wallet record and updates the stored approval threshold. This changes who can approve transactions for that wallet.

params.name: wallet_id
params.description: Internal ID of the multisig wallet

params.name: new_signer_address
params.description: Address of the signer to add

params.name: new_approval_threshold
params.description: Number of signatures required after the change

tools.code:
import json
import sqlite3
from langchain.tools import tool

_DATABASE_PATH = "wallets.db"


@tool
def add_multisig_signer(wallet_id: str, new_signer_address: str, new_approval_threshold: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(_DATABASE_PATH)
    existing_wallet_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT signers FROM multisig_wallets WHERE id = ?", (wallet_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if existing_wallet_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "wallet not found"

    current_signer_list = json.loads(existing_wallet_row[0])
    normalized_new_signer_address = new_signer_address.lower()
    if normalized_new_signer_address not in [s.lower() for s in current_signer_list]:
        current_signer_list.append(new_signer_address)

    database_connection.execute(
        "UPDATE multisig_wallets SET signers = ?, threshold = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (json.dumps(current_signer_list), new_approval_threshold, wallet_id),
    )
    database_connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO signer_audit_log (wallet_id, signer, action) VALUES (?, ?, 'added')",
        (wallet_id, new_signer_address),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"signer added, {len(current_signer_list)} signers, threshold {new_approval_threshold}"

tools.name: list_and_revoke_token_approvals
tools.description: Checks the ERC-20 allowance a wallet has granted to a spender and, if it is non-zero, sends a transaction setting the allowance to zero. This revokes the spender's permission to move the token.

params.description: Wallet address that granted the allowance

params.name: spender_address
params.description: Address whose allowance should be revoked

tools.name: send_eth_payment
tools.description: Signs and broadcasts a transfer of ETH from the managed hot wallet to a recipient address. Returns the transaction hash and amount sent.
tools.code:
import os
from web3 import Web3
from agents import function_tool

_w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(os.environ["ETH_RPC_URL"]))
_ACCOUNT = _w3.eth.account.from_key(os.environ["HOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY"])


@function_tool
def send_eth_payment(recipient_address: str, amount_eth: float) -> dict:
    recipient = Web3.to_checksum_address(recipient_address)
    value_wei = Web3.to_wei(amount_eth, "ether")
    transaction = {
        "to": recipient,
        "value": value_wei,
        "gas": 21000,
        "maxFeePerGas": _w3.eth.gas_price * 2,
        "maxPriorityFeePerGas": Web3.to_wei(2, "gwei"),
        "nonce": _w3.eth.get_transaction_count(_ACCOUNT.address),
        "chainId": _w3.eth.chain_id,
    }
    signed = _ACCOUNT.sign_transaction(transaction)
    tx_hash = _w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed.raw_transaction)
    result = {
        "status": "submitted",
        "tx_hash": tx_hash.hex(),
        "from": _ACCOUNT.address,
        "to": recipient,
        "amount_eth": amount_eth,
    }
    return result
